name: Claude
notes: Car: the hot-hatch preset (£29,700, FWD 2.0 turbo, sport tyres, ABS+TC). A forgiving, understeery front-driver is the easiest platform for a learned policy: front-drive power-on understeer is self-correcting, and ABS/TC absorb crude pedal outputs. Under £60k, extra power mostly adds ways to crash. Driver: small tanh MLP (79→24→12→2, steer + combined pedal), with OpenAI-ES (antithetic sampling, centred ranks, Adam).
